messages.subject: Project Quartz — completion / executed Patent Licence Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam, all,

I'm pleased to confirm completion of Project Quartz. Both the Patent Licence Agreement and the side letter have been executed by the parties and the £1.25m upfront fee has been received by Aldridge. The fully executed licence is attached for the deal bible. Conformed copies and the completion bible will follow next week.

It's been a pleasure working with you and Marcus on this.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
